blocks.text: Have you ever wondered how businesses manage their finances and promote their products? Banking and advertising are crucial in facilitating trade.

blocks.markdown: In the world of commerce, banks play a vital role in managing money and providing financial services. They help businesses and individuals save, borrow, and invest. Advertising, on the other hand, is essential for promoting goods and services to potential customers.

blocks.title: What is Banking?
blocks.text: Banking refers to the business conducted or services offered by a bank, which includes accepting deposits, providing loans, and offering financial advice.

blocks.markdown: The Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) is responsible for regulating the banking sector and ensuring monetary stability. Commercial banks, like First Bank and Access Bank, provide various services such as savings accounts, loans, and payment processing.

blocks.title: Understanding Cheques
blocks.prompt: Aisha wants to pay her supplier, Mr. Ade, using a cheque. What steps does she need to follow?

steps.text: Aisha writes the amount and the name of the payee, Mr. Ade, on the cheque.
She signs the cheque and hands it over to Mr. Ade, who can then deposit it into his bank account.

blocks.answer: Aisha successfully uses a cheque to pay Mr. Ade.

blocks.markdown: In addition to cheques, banks offer services like standing orders and bank drafts. A standing order allows regular payments to be made automatically, while a bank draft is a secure method of payment guaranteed by the bank.

blocks.title: Tip for Exam Success
blocks.text: Remember to differentiate between the functions of the Central Bank and commercial banks. Understanding these distinctions can help you answer exam questions accurately.

blocks.markdown: Advertising is another essential aid to trade. It involves communicating with potential customers to inform them about products and services. Different types of advertising include print, broadcast, and digital media.

blocks.title: Functions of Advertising
blocks.text: The main functions of advertising are to inform, persuade, and remind customers about products and services.

points: Banks provide essential financial services that facilitate trade.
Advertising helps businesses reach their target audience and promote their offerings.
